text: Ɓe ɗiɗo kala ɓe adondiri ka baafal: Yuusufa hari ko no daɗndira hoore-mun, debbo on kan ko fii haɗugol mo yaltugol. O nanngi dolokke makko fii wata o yaltu, o seekiri mo ɓaawo. Ɓe tawi moodi makko ka baafal. Debbo on wowlirani moodi mun ƴoƴre: Lepte alanaa on faalanaaɗo ɓeyngu maa bonki si wanaa kaso maa o leptiree lepte muusuɗe.
